normalized.result:
The failure handling and long-text behavior look right. Letting me complete the details manually is much better than refusing a valid link just because the page cannot be reached.

I don’t think exploration is complete yet, though. Before building, I still want us to settle several parts of managing a larger library:

- Choosing how links are sorted, such as by date added or title.
- Selecting several links and acting on them together: add or remove tags, mark read or unread, archive, or delete. I should also be able to apply an action to every link matching the current search, tag, or view.
- Saving a reusable view made from search words plus tags to include or exclude.
- Keeping a preserved copy of a page, with PDFs stored as PDFs, and optionally sending a copy to the Internet Archive.
- Importing and exporting standard browser-bookmark HTML while retaining titles, tags, and original saved dates.
- Personal display choices such as the default order, how many links are shown, and text size.

Those are important to the “manage” part of the app, so I’d like to explore them before treating the scope as settled.
